payload.text: D-tsk28x-4: truc danh tinh co BA toa do, khong phai hai -- muc dich (don tri, mo cham, => thu muc) + vai tro (don tri, DONG, => ten file) + entity (DA TRI, mo nhanh, => tag frontmatter). Entity KHONG BAO GIO lam thu muc
payload.rationale: Chu san pham neu vong 9 (2026-08-25): mot audience can tai lieu theo muc dich su dung, trong mot tai lieu chua nhieu entity, cac entity duoc dung lai o nhieu loai tai lieu khac. Do kiem: 93/330 tai lieu (28 phan tram) nhac >=2 entity ngay trong TEN FILE, than bai con nhieu hon -- nen entity da tri, khong the lam toa do luu tru don tri. Sua loi session dung chu doi tuong theo hai nghia (vung van de vs entity). Tien le OKF: authoritative_for (don) tach khoi areas/tags (da), ghi tu vong 2 nhung session lay thieu nua sau.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-5: Diataxis va moi framework viet KHONG duoc lam thu muc -- quadrant thoi quyet noi luu. Layout moi docs/<muc-dich>/<vai-tro>.md, duong dan CHINH LA cap danh tinh don tri nen chong-trung duoc he tep cuong che mien phi, khong can anti-fork gate
payload.rationale: Chu san pham bat loi vong 9: section 6.1 da chan doan tu vong 3 rang truc Diataxis dang ganh ba viec (cach viet + noi luu + danh sach duy nhat), ca thiet ke sinh ra de go viec 2-3 khoi no, nhung session van viet docs/<quadrant>/<topic>.md. Khong chi thieu nhat quan: no chan thang D-tsk28x-3 (registry mo nhieu framework) vi framework thu hai khong co thu muc tuong ung. Chu san pham chon duong luu theo muc dich; session tu rut lai phan doi vi fold va doi la CUNG MOT thao tac chu khong phai hai.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-6: registry luu bang event trong .fgos/ + verb rieng (fgos topic register/split/merge/rename/retire), BAT BUOC kem hai anh cuoi cung theo audience -- JSON cho may (skill tra luc ghi, doctor kiem) + Markdown cho nguoi (mo ra cam nhan hinh dang), kem doctor check topic-index-stale
payload.rationale: Chu san pham chon phuong an event+verb nhung dat dieu kien: luon phai co anh cuoi cung, vi ep vao store thi kho cam nhan hinh dang cuoi cung cua docs. Dieu kien nay cuu chinh phuong an: thieu anh thi doi mot van de (troi) lay mot van de khac (khong nhin duoc). Repo da chay khuon nay hai lan: docs/decisions/index.md sinh tu state.decisions, va docs/enduser-docs-index.json. Theo D-ADR0008 chon dinh dang theo audience tung interface nen phai DUNG HAI anh. Anh Markdown phai cho thay thu ls khong thay: lineage bien hinh, topic da dang ky ma chua co tai lieu, topic qua nguong cho tach, topic da nghi huu va ai thay.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-7: registry BIEN HINH duoc va bat buoc phai bien hinh -- DONG phan cau truc/schema/luat-chon-luc-ghi, MO danh sach topic. Vai tro la DONG CO CUA: khong duoc bia inline, them mot vai tro la su kien co ghi lai qua verb. Phien DE XUAT khong chan, nguoi chot theo lo. Tach kich hoat bang doctor check do kich thuoc, khong phai nguoi nho
payload.rationale: Ap cau vocabulary cau truc DONG + du lieu chu de MO cua OKF (ghi tu vong 2) xuong mot tang. Nam thao tac: register/split/merge/rename/retire, dung lai luat repo da co (supersede khong sua tai cho). Tach topic la dung loai viec khong ai nho lam, nhung tin hieu tach do duoc bang may (tai lieu vuot nguong) nen doctor check bien bao tri tu hy-vong-co-nguoi-de-y thanh may-chi-mat -- day la cach R6 duoc thoa. Guard chong troi: vai tro chi co dung mot tai lieu la vai tro dang ngo, dem duoc bang doctor. Phien de xuat khong chan la de khop uu tien so 2 Release con nguoi trong AGENTS.md: gom cau hoi thanh bo, khong cau hoi treo nao chan viec khac tien.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-8: MOT bo may phuc vu HAI tang nhung HAI registry tach roi -- tang nguoi (end-user docs) toi uu do ro, chap nhan trung lap co chu dich vi phuc vu nhieu doi tuong doc; tang may (docs/specs/) toi uu do gon, du la dung. Chung verb + anh cuoi cung + doctor check, KHONG chung vocabulary, KHONG chung nguong
payload.rationale: Chu san pham chot vong 9: nen co mot bo may phuc vu 2 tang va nen tach, vi viet cho nguoi cang ro cang chi tiet cang tot va co the trung tai lieu vi viet cho nhieu nguoi, nhung cho may thi chi can du va gon. Hai tang toi uu NGUOC CHIEU nhau nen ep chung vocabulary se keo mot trong hai ve sai huong toi uu cua no. Loi ich phu da do: Area Map dang troi (herdr-web-dashboard la area song mang 20 quyet dinh ma thieu trong danh sach system-overview.md) -- cuoi chung bo may thi het troi.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-9: docPath cu la SU THAT LICH SU (luc do tai lieu viet o day), khong bao gio sua; topic X hien song o file nao la BAN CHIEU hien tai do registry tra loi qua lineage split/merge. Voi layout moi, bang anh xa cu sang moi la viec NGAY DAU, khong phai cai tien sau
payload.rationale: Ap thang D-ADR0001 (nhat ky su kien la su that, store la ban chieu dung lai duoc). Tach topic lam gay linkage vi findAllSourceCaptureIds khop docPath chinh xac tung ky tu (src/report/enduser-index.mjs). He qua thi cong phai mang theo: findAllSourceCaptureIds va verb fgos doc-sources phai biet den registry, khong con so khop chuoi thuan. Duoi phuong an giu nguyen thu muc thi viec nay hoan duoc; duoi phuong an luu theo muc dich thi khong -- neu thieu, fgos doc-sources gay cho TOAN BO tai lieu cu ngay khi doi.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-10: HAI TRUC trien khai CUNG LUC, khong tuan tu -- bi EP boi hinh dang contract cua skill viet tai lieu, khong phai lua chon pham vi. Contract gom {muc dich, vai tro, entity[]} (danh tinh: ghi vao dau) + {framework+mode} (cach viet: nap expertise nao) + {capture that}; thieu mot trong hai truc thi contract khong well-formed
payload.rationale: Chu san pham chot vong 9 kem mo ta skill viet: co contract dau vao ro rang mo ta tai lieu se viet/cap nhat, dua vao metadata thi mot hoac nhieu ky nang viet duoc nap boi chinh skill do roi dung expertise do de viet. Session RUT LAI nghieng-ve-lam-tuan-tu neu cuoi vong 9 (ly do sai: chua nhin ra hai truc gap nhau tai dung contract nay). Tra loi luon cau vong 4(d) treo tu 2026-08-07. Co che nap expertise da co tien le chay that: .agents/skills/_shared/ (executor-dispatch-fallback.md 18K, citation-format.md 4.4K) -- manh chuyen mon dung chung, skill tro vao chu khong chep lai.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-11: fold 268 tai lieu chia HAI PHA khac han ban chat -- pha 1 phan loai tung file (doc lap, song song, dau ra la DU LIEU) CHINH LA pass bottom-up sinh vocabulary, mot viec chu khong phai hai; pha 2 gop va viet ~33 tai lieu dich (song song theo dich, dong thoi la phep thu that dau tien cua skill viet). Guard bat buoc: conservation
payload.rationale: Chu san pham chon Cau A=2 (bottom-up suy vocabulary tu 268 tai lieu that) va Cau B=a (fold nguoc toan bo, chi thi cong sau khi registry chot). Phat hien: pha 1 va pass bottom-up la CUNG MOT thao tac -- lan thu hai trong thao luan nay hai viec tuong roi hoa ra la mot (lan dau: fold va doi). Trinh tu: (1) mot pass phan loai 268 file ra vocabulary ung vien + bang gan; (2) nguoi duyet vocabulary tren DU LIEU THAT, luc do moi chot danh sach vai tro; (3) pha 2 song song theo dich. Conservation port thang tu bai hoc B6b da ghi o section 6.5: moi file trong 268 phai duoc ke ten DUNG MOT LAN, hoac trong danh sach nguon cua mot dich hoac trong phan loai tru co ly do, thieu mot cai la nem loi -- day la cach duy nhat dam bao R3 (nuoi la bo sung khong mat) khong bi vi pham am tham khi gop 8 nguon thanh 1. Canh bao: fanout tung dua worktree phai lui ve tuan tu, pha 2 neu chay song song phai pin worktree tu te.

payload.text: D-tsk28x-12: TACH nua thu-chat-lieu-ke-chuyen thanh item rieng -- tsk-28x giu truc danh tinh + topic registry + skill viet; phan thu chat lieu (nguong per-item, ban nhap = chat lieu da trich, noi item voi commit) di item khac. Moc mo lai = ngay sau khi mint, khong phai cho registry xay xong
payload.rationale: Chu san pham chot vong 9. Phat hien lam scope co lai: mo hinh bon nhan da giai xong phan lon nua dang dong bang ma chua ai noi. De bai goc noi changelog va marketing-story khong co cho ngoi hop le vi Diataxis vua la truc duy nhat vua quyet noi luu va hard rule cam viet ngoai docs/<quadrant>/ -- rang buoc do vua tan (D-tsk28x-5). Va Keep a Changelog CHINH LA mot framework viet thu hai, dung thu D-tsk28x-3 tien doan se toi; marketing-story dung narrative-arc. Ca hai cam vao truc cach viet nhu framework binh dang, khong can producer registry rieng, khong can quadrant thu nam. Cai con lai that su chi la co che KHAI THAC du lieu (thu chat lieu), khac han ban chat voi viec TO CHUC tai lieu -- nen tach.
